propositions: outbound_differ.py exceeds the 800 LOC hard module-size cap enforced by CI gate, blocking S3 and S6 features that require adding code to it

the two mutation builder functions _compute_outbound_create_mutation (~108 LOC) and _compute_outbound_update_mutation (~167 LOC) form an extractable call-graph seam, both called only by compute_outbound_mutations orchestrator

extracting the mutation builders into a new outbound_mutation_builders.py module reduces outbound_differ.py to ~525 LOC and creates a new module ~290 LOC, both within target band and under the 800 cap
all public import paths (compute_outbound_mutations, OutboundDiffConfig, OutboundMutation) must remain stable; private-name importers receive re-exports from outbound_differ
the existing outbound-differ test suite and module-size contract test are the sole oracles; no new behavioural tests are authored for a pure behaviour-preserving refactor
